decision.inconclusive: Uncompleted solve/intake, unclassified software/numerical failure, missing required work or resource/clock/source interruption.
decision.negative: Complete eligible score misses threshold, or fully recorded ineligible training domain.
decision.positive: Complete eligible score <=0.99 times frozen reference training score: merits separately registered validation.

execution_prerequisites: Clean reviewed producer, exact configuration and dependency inventories.
Pre-execution software checks and adversarial review.
Fresh output, AC power and owned temporary sleep assertions.

host.cleanup: After scientific session is terminal, terminate owned assertion process, poll to terminal, verify absence; use sandbox escalation if required. Preserve every attempt.
host.conditions: AC and both owned sleep assertions at admission, sampled during execution and after scientific termination; failed query or observed AC/assertion loss makes enclosing result inconclusive.
host.limits: No proof of continuous host conditions or external-load control; assertion is not a scientific watchdog.

rationale: Three-point quadratic of frozen training scores suggests an unvalidated interior minimum near +0.34417mm; fixed +0.35mm tests that hypothesis without fitting coils.

reference.availability: local archive only; exact source report required

science.intake: Original size, equilibrium, flux/sign and independent field/geometry checks.
science.unchanged_input_fields: All except the one registered coefficient, with no rescaling, resolution or tolerance changes.
